lines.en: label otohadorm1:
scene otohadark1
: Welp, that was fucking weird.
lines.zh: : 唉，那真是他妈的诡异。

lines.en: : You don’t actually need help carrying anything, do you?
lines.zh: : 你其实不需要人帮你搬东西吧？

lines.en: : No. I don’t actually need help carrying anything.
lines.zh: : 不。我确实不需要人帮忙搬东西。

lines.en: : I just figured you could probably use a break after whatever the hell that was.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，在经历了那场莫名其妙的事之后，你大概需要喘口气。

lines.en: : I take it that means you don’t have any idea either?
lines.zh: : 那是不是意味着你也一头雾水？

lines.en: : Not a clue.
lines.zh: : 一点头绪都没有。

lines.en: : Nodoka and me have been friends for a little while but we’re not like, {i}super{/i} close or anything.
lines.zh: : 我和 Nodoka 当朋友有一阵子了，但我们不算{i}特别{/i}亲密什么的。

lines.en: : Like, it was a little weird how far she went to get me to move over here in the first place.
lines.zh: : 就说，她为了让我搬过来居然做到那种地步，本身就挺奇怪的。

lines.en: : So understanding her right off the bat is kind of too much for me to be able to do right now.
lines.zh: : 所以现在要我一下子就理解她，有点强人所难。

lines.en: scene otohadark2
: But if I figure anything out, I’ll be sure to let you know.
lines.zh: : 不过如果我想通了什么，一定会告诉你。

lines.en: : She’s not really one to ever explain herself, though.
lines.zh: : 不过她不太是会为自己解释的人。

lines.en: : I’ve heard similar stories in the past about how she’s taken things too far and wound up causing some people to feel really uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 我以前也听过类似的事，说她做得太过火，结果让一些人非常不舒服。

lines.en: : We can probably just chalk it up to her being a weirdo, though.
lines.zh: : 不过大概可以简单归结为她就是个怪人吧。

lines.en: : Well I’m definitely used to dealing with “weirdos” by now, so one more surely won’t change anything.
lines.zh: : 嗯，现在我早就习惯应付「怪人」了，所以多一个肯定也不会改变什么。

lines.en: : Hey, man. You said it, not me.
lines.zh: : 嘿，老兄。这话是你说的，不是我。

lines.en: : You can say it too, if you want. It’s not like I’d go around telling everyone that you called them weird.
lines.zh: : 你想说也可以说啊。我又不会到处跟人说你管她们叫怪人。

lines.en: scene otohadark3
: No no no. That’s not what I’m getting at.
lines.zh: : 不不不。我不是这个意思。

lines.en: : Like, yeah, you’ve got a truck load of...eccentric people in your class, but I think everyone has their own reasons for acting how they do.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你们班确实有一卡车……古怪的人，但我觉得每个人都有自己的理由才表现得那样。

lines.en: : So I don’t mean they’re weird in like, a negative way or whatever. They’re weird in the kind of way that makes them interesting to talk to.
lines.zh: : 所以我说她们怪，不是贬义什么的。她们是那种让人聊起来很有意思的怪。

lines.en: : Sure. Though, trying to have someone admit that they want to hook up with everyone in a room isn't exactly the “good” kind of weird that you’re alluding to.
lines.zh: : 当然。不过，逼着别人承认自己想跟屋里所有人乱搞，可算不上你暗指的「好」的那种怪。

lines.en: scene otohadark4
: I think what Nodoka was doing was a little more than that, dude.
lines.zh: : 我觉得 Nodoka 干的事可不止那个，老兄。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure she was just seeing how far she could push you without you snapping back at her or whatever.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定她只是在试探能把你逼到什么程度，而你又不会反过来发作什么的。

lines.en: : You did pretty well, all things considered.
lines.zh: : 总的来看，你做得相当不错。

lines.en: : I’m just hoping she’s not up there feeling all weird about it now.
lines.zh: : 我只希望她现在在楼上不会因此觉得别扭。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure she’s just ordering pizza. I don’t think she cares too much about the aftermath.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定她只是在订披萨。我觉得她不太在意后续。

lines.en: scene otohadark2
: No, but the two people she’s up there with do.
lines.zh: : 是不在意，可跟她一起在楼上的那两个人在意。

lines.en: : And she’s also really close to Futaba, so she might feel weird if she’s suddenly uncomfortable or something.
lines.zh: : 而且她跟 Futaba 也特别亲近，所以如果对方突然觉得不舒服什么的，她可能会觉得别扭。

lines.en: : I don’t know, man. I’m not great at this whole positive reinforcement thing.
lines.zh: : 我也说不好，老兄。我不是很擅长这种正面鼓励的事。

lines.en: : I just want to make sure things don’t get weird again once we go back up.
lines.zh: : 我只是想确保我们回去之后别又变得怪怪的。

lines.en: : Not even the good kind of weird?
lines.zh: : 连好的那种怪都不要吗？

lines.en: scene otohadark5
: Pfft, no. Not even the good kind of weird.
lines.zh: : 噗，不要。连好的那种怪也不要。

lines.en: scene otohadark6
: Is it too much to ask to just have a chill night with my friends?
lines.zh: : 我只是想跟朋友们过一个轻松的夜晚，这要求很过分吗？

lines.en: : I just got here. I’m not ready for weird[teen]drama yet. Especially drama involving some dude who’s way too old to even be hanging around us.
lines.zh: : 我才刚来。我还没准备好应付诡异的[teen]剧情。尤其是牵涉到某个年纪大到根本不该跟我们混在一起的男人的剧情。

lines.en: : So thanks for not admitting to manipulating the entire girls' dorm or whatever it was that we’re assuming Nodoka wanted you to do.
lines.zh: : 所以谢谢你没承认自己操纵了整个女生宿舍，或者我们猜 Nodoka 想让你做的那件事什么的。

lines.en: : You made my life slightly easier by holding back.
lines.zh: : 你忍住没说，让我的日子稍微好过了一点。

lines.en: : No problem. I’m going to ask that you rescind your comment about me being too old, though. That hurt.
lines.zh: : 不客气。不过我想请你收回那句说我太老的话。那挺伤人的。

lines.en: : Dude, you’re totally too old. I’m not rescinding anything.
lines.zh: : 老兄，你是真的太老了。我一个字都不收回。

lines.en: : Your rationality regarding this topic isn’t something I normally deal with. I don’t know if I should be relieved or offended.
lines.zh: : 你在这种话题上的理性，我平时可不常见。我不知道该松口气还是该觉得被冒犯。

lines.en: : Be whatever you want to be. That’s what my mom always says.
lines.zh: : 成为你想成为的人吧。我妈总这么说。

lines.en: scene otohadark7
: As long as “whatever you want to be” doesn’t include “musician,” of course.
lines.zh: : 当然，只要「你想成为的人」里不包括「音乐家」。

lines.en: : I definitely don’t think you have to worry about me pursuing that career path any time soon.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定你不用担心我短期内会走那条职业道路。

lines.en: scene otohadark6
: Good. Last thing I need is some old guy showing up to one of my shows and stealing my entire audience.
lines.zh: : 那就好。我最不需要的，就是某个老男人出现在我的演出上，把我的观众全抢走。

lines.en: A cold breeze forms from wherever it is wind comes from (My guess is the sky, but I’m sure it’s a little more complicated than that) and attacks the two of us outside of the dorm.
lines.zh: 一阵冷风从风该来的地方生成（我猜是天上，不过我肯定实际比这复杂一点），在宿舍外面向我们俩袭来。

lines.en: I rarely have extended conversations out here, but...they're kind of nice in a weird sort of way.
lines.zh: 我很少在外面进行长时间的交谈，不过……它们以一种奇怪的方式来说还挺不错。

lines.en: The good kind of weird, obviously.
lines.zh: 当然是好的那种怪。

lines.en: We left any residual “bad” weirdness upstairs with one girl I can’t understand and two that I’m starting to.
lines.zh: 我们把残余的「坏」怪异留在了楼上——留给一个我无法理解的女孩，和两个我开始能理解的。

lines.en: Is it strange that I’m not sure which of those two categories Otoha fits into yet?
lines.zh: 我还不确定 Otoha 属于这两类中的哪一类，这算奇怪吗？

lines.en: I want to say that I get who she is and what she’s thinking-
lines.zh: 我想说我懂她是谁、她在想什么——

lines.en: But if there’s anything I’ve learned from my time in Kumon-mi, it’s that you can never truly know anything.
lines.zh: 但如果说我在 Kumon-mi 的日子里学到了什么，那就是你永远无法真正了解任何事。

lines.en: I’ve also learned that having sex with [teenager]s is awesome and suddenly feel the need to remind you of that.
lines.zh: 我还学到，和 [teenager] 做爱爽极了，而且我突然觉得有必要提醒你这一点。

lines.en: I’m sure if Nodoka could hear my thoughts, she’d be smiling right about now.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，如果 Nodoka 能听见我的想法，她现在一定在笑。

lines.en: scene otohadark8
: Hey. So, umm...there {i}is{/i} another reason I wanted to come down here with you.
lines.zh: : 嘿。那个，呃……我想跟你下来还有{i}另一个{/i}原因。

lines.en: : Otoha, if you wanted to confess to me, it would have been a lot easier to just do it during Nodoka’s rant before.
lines.zh: : Otoha，如果你想跟我告白，刚才 Nodoka 发飙的时候直接说会容易得多。

lines.en: scene otohadark9
: Dude, I already told you you’re way too old.
lines.zh: : 老兄，我都说了你太老了。

lines.en: : So old that I’m asking you for advice instead of asking you to like...hold my hand or whatever.
lines.zh: : 老到我是来找你征求意见的，而不是要你……牵我的手什么的。

lines.en: : Advice? I feel like you’re going to regret this decision.
lines.zh: : 征求意见？我感觉你会后悔这个决定。

lines.en: : I am very bad with advice.
lines.zh: : 我最不会给人出主意了。

lines.en: : And I’m bad with a lot of stuff. But what the hell will avoiding it solve?
lines.zh: : 而且我很多事都不擅长。可一味逃避又能解决什么？

lines.en: : Worse comes to worst, I can just blame {i}you{/i} for my life falling apart and use that momentum to write some cool midwest emo shit or something.
lines.zh: : 最坏的情况，我就把自己人生崩塌的责任推到{i}你{/i}头上，借着那股劲儿写点酷酷的中西部 emo 什么的。

lines.en: : Rin would be all about that.
lines.zh: : Rin 肯定很吃这套。

lines.en: : Yeah. I understand exactly what you’re talking about right now.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我完全明白你现在在说什么。

lines.en: scene otohadark10
: Good. Because Rin’s...kind of what I wanted to talk to you about.
lines.zh: : 那就好。因为 Rin……差不多就是我想跟你聊的事。

lines.en: : Ahh. Yeah, I guess that explains why you didn’t want her to tag along.
lines.zh: : 啊。是啊，我想这就能解释为什么你不想让她跟着来。

lines.en: : So much for that thing you said about not talking about people behind their back, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你之前说的不在背后议论别人，看来是白说了。

lines.en: scene otohadark11
: Yeah. So much for that...
lines.zh: : 是啊。白说了……

lines.en: : So, what is it you want to know about her?
lines.zh: : 那么，你想知道她什么？

lines.en: : I don’t mean to brag, but I’ve gotten to know her pretty well over the definitely-only-one[school] year we’ve known each other for.
lines.zh: : 我不是想吹牛，不过在我们认识的这——绝对只有一个[school]年——里，我已经挺了解她了。

lines.en: : Weird choice of words, but I’m just kind of curious about...I don’t know. What kind of person she is, I guess?
lines.zh: : 这措辞挺怪的，不过我只是有点好奇……我不知道。大概是她是怎样的人？

lines.en: : Do you not already know what kind of person she is by now? Don’t you two talk like all day, everyday?
lines.zh: : 你到现在还不知道她是怎样的人吗？你们俩不是整天都在聊吗？

lines.en: : It’s like, 80%% Rin talking and 20%% me figuring out how I'm supposed to reply.
lines.zh: : 大概就是，80%% 是 Rin 在说，20%% 是我在想该怎么回。

lines.en: : I get that she’s nice and has her own problems that she’s still working out or whatever, but like...I’m kind of confused, you know?
lines.zh: : 我知道她人很好，也有自己还在解决的烦恼什么的，不过……我有点搞不懂，你懂吧？

lines.en: : Like, didn’t she like some other girl right before me?
lines.zh: : 就说，她在我之前不是喜欢过别的女生吗？

lines.en: : It’s really flattering...all of the things she says about me. But I can’t help but feel like I’m just the flavor of the month or something.
lines.zh: : 她说的那些关于我的话真的很让人开心……可我忍不住觉得自己只是这个月的限定口味什么的。

lines.en: scene otohadark12
: There are so many parks with so many girls.
lines.zh: : 公园那么多，女生那么多。

lines.en: : If she fell for {i}me{/i} so quickly...who’s to say that won’t happen again with the next rocker chick she lays her eyes on?
lines.zh: : 如果她这么快就爱上{i}我{/i}……谁说得准她看上下一个摇滚妹子时不会再来一次？

lines.en: : No one would say that won’t happen, because it very well may.
lines.zh: : 没人会说那不会发生，因为它很可能发生。

lines.en: : Right? So then why should I believe-
lines.zh: : 对吧？那我凭什么要相信——

lines.en: : Because you’re at the part of your life where what's happening right now matters a lot more than what’s going to happen in a few weeks.
lines.zh: : 因为你正处在人生的这个阶段——眼下发生的事，比几周后会发生的事重要得多。

lines.en: scene otohadark13
: Wait. I am?
lines.zh: : 等等。是吗？

lines.en: : I thought I was at the part of life where I {i}should{/i} be thinking about my future.
lines.zh: : 我以为我正处在{i}应该{/i}思考未来的那个阶段。

lines.en: : That’s what most people in my position would probably tell you. I work a little differently, though.
lines.zh: : 处在我这个位置的大多数人大概都会这么跟你说。不过我的想法有点不一样。

lines.en: : I think the best way to ensure that your future winds up being something exciting is to live freely day to day.
lines.zh: : 我觉得，要确保你的未来最终变得精彩，最好的办法就是每天都活得自由自在。

lines.en: : That way, you won’t have any regrets weighing you down once you get older.
lines.zh: : 这样等你老了，就不会有任何悔恨压在你身上。

lines.en: : Okay but like, what about gaining experience and like...furthering my education and stuff.
lines.zh: : 好吧，可是……积累经验、还有……继续深造什么的呢。

lines.en: : Two sacrifices that must be made in exchange for happiness.
lines.zh: : 那是换取幸福必须做出的两项牺牲。

lines.en: scene otohadark14
: This is very bad advice, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 这建议糟透了，Sensei。

lines.en: : Hey, no one is perfect.
lines.zh: : 嘿，人无完人嘛。

lines.en: : Point is, if you want to learn more about Rin, learn more about her by spending time with her.
lines.zh: : 重点是，如果你想更了解 Rin，就花时间跟她待在一起来了解她。

lines.en: : I’m going to, totally. I think she’s really cool.
lines.zh: : 我肯定会。我觉得她真的很酷。

lines.en: : I don’t know if I want to like, {i}date{/i} her, but being around her has been fun so far.
lines.zh: : 我不知道自己想不想跟她{i}交往{/i}，不过到目前为止跟她在一起挺开心的。

lines.en: : She’s just kind of...
lines.zh: : 她只是有点……

lines.en: : I don’t know. A little too much for me sometimes?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。有时候对我来说有点太超过了？

lines.en: : She has {i}a lot{/i} of personality.
lines.zh: : 她的个性{i}非常{/i}鲜明。

lines.en: : True. But so does Nodoka and you two seem to be doing well so far.
lines.zh: : 没错。可 Nodoka 也一样，而你们俩到目前为止相处得还不错。

lines.en: scene otohadark15
: I can’t help but feel like I do nothing but attract loud or...strange people.
lines.zh: : 我忍不住觉得，我吸引来的全是吵闹的或者……奇怪的人。

lines.en: : Have you tried taking some of your rings off?
lines.zh: : 你有没有试过把你那些戒指摘掉几个？

lines.en: : What...would that do?
lines.zh: : 那……有什么用？

lines.en: : I don’t know. Make you seem less...cool?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。让你看起来不那么……酷？

lines.en: : I hope it’s a little more than just my jewelry that makes people gravitate to me.
lines.zh: : 我希望吸引别人靠近我的，不只是我的首饰。

lines.en: scene otohadark16
: Who knows at this point, though?
lines.zh: : 不过到这地步谁知道呢？

lines.en: : It’s gotta be {i}something{/i} weird like that if I keep attracting so many girls.
lines.zh: : 如果我一直吸引这么多女生，那一定是{i}某种{/i}像这样奇怪的东西在起作用。

lines.en: : To be fair, there are a lot less guys around to attract now.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，现在能吸引的男生少多了。

lines.en: : Ahh, yes. When in doubt, blame it on the space war.
lines.zh: : 啊，对。拿不准的时候就怪太空战争。

lines.en: : It wouldn’t be the first time, I can tell you that.
lines.zh: : 这可不是第一次了，这我可以告诉你。

lines.en: scene otohadark17
: What would you do in my shoes, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei，如果你是我会怎么做？

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 什么意思？

lines.en: : About Rin.
lines.zh: : 关于 Rin。

lines.en: : Oh. Uhh...
: I think the complete answer to that question would be better received by someone like Nodoka rather than you.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那个问题的完整答案，由 Nodoka 那样的人来说会比跟你说更好。

lines.en: : I’m not sure you’re prepared for what I’d say.
lines.zh: : 我不确定你已经准备好听我要说的话。

lines.en: scene otohadark18
: Uhh...no. Probably not, if that’s the direction you’re going to take things in.
lines.zh: : 呃……大概没有，如果你要往那个方向说的话。

lines.en: : Hearing what I’d do shouldn’t influence you at all anyway. Live your life how {i}you{/i} want to. Not how someone else would.
lines.zh: : 反正听我说我会怎么做，也不该影响你。按{i}你{/i}想要的方式过你的人生。而不是按别人会怎么做。

lines.en: : Whatever you do decide on, though, be gentle with her.
lines.zh: : 不过不管你最后怎么决定，对她温柔点。

lines.en: : And I’m not talking sexually this time because she has so much pent up sexual frustration at this point that I don’t think being gentle would-
lines.zh: : 而且这次我不是说在性方面——因为她到这地步已经积压了太多性欲，我觉得温柔点恐怕——

lines.en: scene otohadark19
: Dude.
lines.zh: : 老兄。

lines.en: : Sorry. I couldn’t help myself.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我忍不住。

lines.en: scene otohadark20
: It’s fine. I’ll be as gentle as I can with...whichever direction we wind up going in.
lines.zh: : 没事。不管我们最后走向哪个方向，我都会尽可能温柔。

lines.en: : I don’t want to hurt her. But I don’t know if I can make her happy either.
lines.zh: : 我不想伤害她。可我也不知道自己能不能让她幸福。

lines.en: : If I’m going to be making my own choices now, I shouldn’t be making any that I can’t get behind 100%% of the way.
lines.zh: : 既然现在要自己做选择，我就不该做任何我没法 100%% 认同的选择。

lines.en: : It’s kind of crazy to me how quickly some people are willing to jump into things like...confessing their feelings when I can’t even figure out what mine are.
lines.zh: : 有些人能那么快就跳进去……比如告白，而我自己连自己的感情是什么都搞不清，这让我觉得挺疯狂的。

lines.en: : You write music don’t you? Maybe you’re just...using up all of your emotions on that?
lines.zh: : 你写音乐的吧？也许你只是……把情绪都花在那上面了？

lines.en: scene otohadark21
: Right. Because emotions are a finite resource that you can run out of if you use too many.
lines.zh: : 对啊。因为情绪是一种有限资源，用多了就会耗尽。

lines.en: : You joke, but what if that’s actually true?
lines.zh: : 你在开玩笑，可万一真是这样呢？

lines.en: : If that’s true, this world is an extremely sad place.
lines.zh: : 如果真是这样，这个世界就太可悲了。

lines.en: : Oh! There you two are.
lines.zh: : 哦！你们俩在这儿。

lines.en: scene otohadark22
This world {i}is{/i} an extremely sad place.
lines.zh: 这个世界{i}确实{/i}是个极其可悲的地方。

lines.en: If it was any sadder, we’d all shrivel up and die.
lines.zh: 要是再悲哀一点，我们所有人都会枯萎而死。

lines.en: Which I’m sure is something we’ve all felt like doing at least once or twice.
lines.zh: 而我敢肯定，我们每个人都有过至少一两次想那么做的念头。

lines.en: Maybe even thousands of times, depending on the person.
lines.zh: 取决于是什么人，说不定想过几千次。

lines.en: Take these two, for example.
lines.zh: 就拿这两个人来说吧。

lines.en: They’re both smiling, are they not?
lines.zh: 她们俩都在笑，不是吗？

lines.en: Which smile do you think is harder to maintain?
lines.zh: 你觉得哪一个笑容更难维持？

lines.en: The one belonging to the girl who wants to love, yet doesn’t know how?
lines.zh: 是属于那个想要去爱、却不懂该怎么爱的女孩的那个？

lines.en: Or the one that belongs to the girl who doesn’t seem to be capable of {i}not{/i} loving?
lines.zh: 还是属于那个似乎无法{i}不去{/i}爱的女孩的那个？

lines.en: The correct answer is that both smiles are impossible to maintain.
lines.zh: 正确答案是：两个笑容都不可能维持下去。

lines.en: Because this world is miserable.
lines.zh: 因为这个世界很悲惨。

lines.en: And smiling at all is pointless when smiles die faster than anything known to man.
lines.zh: 当笑容比人类已知的任何东西都消逝得更快时，微笑本身就毫无意义。

lines.en: And yet-
lines.zh: 然而——

lines.en: And yet they’re still so inexplicably beautiful.
lines.zh: 然而它们依然美得难以言喻。

lines.en: Maybe tonight, outside of a building filled with dying smiles, I can convince myself to not wish these ones away.
lines.zh: 也许今晚，在一栋装满了正在消逝的笑容的建筑外面，我能说服自己不要盼着这两个笑容也消失。

lines.en: : Yo. Welcome to the party.
lines.zh: : 哟。欢迎来派对。

lines.en: : Thanks for having me.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你们叫我。

lines.en: scene otohadark23
: What are you guys up to? You’ve been down here for a while.
lines.zh: : 你们俩在干嘛呢？在下面待了好久了。

lines.en: : Just hanging out.
lines.zh: : 就随便聊聊。

lines.en: : I had some stuff I wanted to ask him and was afraid Nodoka was going to pounce on him if he hung around any longer.
lines.zh: : 我有些事想问他，又怕他要是在上面多待一会儿，Nodoka 会扑上来。

lines.en: : Yeah, that was weird. She seems fine now, though.
lines.zh: : 是啊，那挺怪的。不过她现在看起来没事了。

lines.en: : You look a little happier than normal, Sensei. Did talking to Otoha put you in a good mood or something?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你看起来比平时开心一点。是跟 Otoha 聊天让你心情变好了还是怎么的？

lines.en: : Me? Looking happy? Are you forgetting who I am, Rin?
lines.zh: : 我？看起来开心？你是不是忘了我是谁了，Rin？

lines.en: : Hmm...It could just be the light, I guess.
lines.zh: : 嗯……大概是灯光的关系吧，我想。

lines.en: scene otohadark24
: Oh. We decided on pepperoni, in case you were wondering.
lines.zh: : 哦。我们决定点意大利辣香肠口味了，以防你们想知道。

lines.en: : I’m sure that’s been on your minds since the two of you came down here so...I just thought I should come let you know and stuff.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定你俩下来之后一直惦记着这件事，所以……我就想过来告诉你们一声什么的。

lines.en: : Thanks, Rin. We were about to head back up anyway, though.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Rin。不过我们本来也正要回去了。

lines.en: : Nah. You two go. I’m going to head home.
lines.zh: : 不用。你们俩上去吧。我要回家了。

lines.en: scene otohadark25
: Wait, I didn’t mess anything up by showing up at a weird time, did I?
lines.zh: : 等等，我不会是挑了个奇怪的时间出现、把什么事搞砸了吧？

lines.en: : I was just...feeling like a third wheel up there and...wanted to be with you two instead.
lines.zh: : 我只是……在上面觉得自己像个电灯泡，然后……想跟你们俩待在一起。

lines.en: : You don’t have to leave, Sensei. You can come back up if you want.
lines.zh: : Sensei，你不用走啊。想的话可以跟我们一起上去。

lines.en: : It’s fine.
lines.zh: : 没事。

lines.en: if rindorm45 == True and rinbetrayed == False:
: Besides, the last time I ate pizza with Rin, something happened that I probably shouldn’t talk about.
lines.zh: : 再说，上次我跟 Rin 一起吃披萨，发生了点我大概不该提的事。

lines.en: scene otohadark26
: Ah! Hey!
lines.zh: : 啊！喂！

lines.en: : Why are you bringing that up now of all times?!
lines.zh: : 你干嘛偏偏挑这个时候说那件事？！

lines.en: : Because it’s more fun to leave after making you flustered.
lines.zh: : 因为把你弄得慌慌张张之后再走，更有意思。

lines.en: : Sensei! Come on!
lines.zh: : Sensei！拜托！

lines.en: : Ami’s probably waiting for me at home anyway. It’s already pretty late.
lines.zh: : 反正 Ami 大概在家等我呢。已经挺晚了。

lines.en: scene otohadark27

lines.zh: : Ami？……

lines.en: : You mean...the Ami from our class?
lines.zh: : 你是说……我们班的那个 Ami？

lines.en: : Does that...mean what I think it means?...
lines.zh: : 那……是我想的那个意思吗？……

lines.en: : I thought hanging around Rin meant you liked girls a little less...you know...
lines.zh: : 我还以为跟 Rin 混在一起意味着你没那么喜欢女生了呢……你懂的……

lines.en: : Ami is my [niece], Otoha.
lines.zh: : Ami 是我的 [niece]，Otoha。

lines.en: scene otohadark28
: I knew that!
lines.zh: : 我早就知道！

lines.en: : I was just kidding anyway!
lines.zh: : 反正我刚才只是开玩笑！

lines.en: : What are {i}you{/i} looking at?
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}在看什么？

lines.en: : It’s...really not because of me?
lines.zh: : 真的……不是因为我？

lines.en: : It’s totally because of you.
lines.zh: : 完全就是因为你。

lines.en: : But also because of some other stuff.
lines.zh: : 不过也因为一些别的事。

lines.en: : I...really don’t care if you stay, you know. I wasn’t trying to get rid of you by coming down here or anything.
lines.zh: : 我……真的不在乎你留不留下来，你知道的。我下来可不是想把你赶走什么的。

lines.en: : Don’t worry about it. Just tell the others that I said goodnight.
lines.zh: : 别放在心上。替我跟其他人说声晚安就行。

lines.en: : And tell Nodoka to deposit whatever points I wound up earning tonight into my account. She knows the bank information.
lines.zh: : 还有，告诉 Nodoka 把我今晚攒下的分数存进我的账户。她知道银行信息。

lines.en: scene otohadark29
: Roger that! Quest accepted!
lines.zh: : 收到！任务已接受！

lines.en: : Uhh...well, goodnight I guess?
lines.zh: : 呃……那么，晚安吧？

lines.en: : We should...talk again sometime, if that’s cool.
lines.zh: : 我们……应该改天再聊聊，如果可以的话。

lines.en: : It’s weirdly relaxing talking to an adult who isn’t telling me to do my homework. Even if that adult is my teacher and probably {i}should{/i} be telling me that.
lines.zh: : 跟一个不催我写作业的大人聊天，莫名地让人放松。哪怕那个大人是我的老师，而且大概{i}本该{/i}催我才对。

lines.en: : Homework is for losers.
lines.zh: : 作业是给失败者做的。

lines.en: : Goodnight, you two.
lines.zh: : 晚安，你们俩。

lines.en: scene otohadark30
: Goodnight! Be safe on the way home, okay?
lines.zh: : 晚安！回家路上小心，好吗？

lines.en: : Goodnight, Sensei. I’ll...see you in[school], I guess.
lines.zh: : 晚安，Sensei。那我……在[school]见吧，我想。

lines.en: scene black
I leave the dorms without the need to stomach the strange sensation that comes with sneaking around.
lines.zh: 我离开宿舍时，不必再忍受偷偷摸摸带来的那种奇怪感觉。

lines.en: To walk down several flights of stairs in hopes of not being spotted by someone I wasn’t there to see.
lines.zh: 走下好几段楼梯，只盼着不被某个我不是来找的人发现。

lines.en: It’s one of the very few positive sides to conversing outside rather than in someone’s bedroom.
lines.zh: 这是不在别人卧室里、而是在外面交谈的极少数好处之一。

lines.en: And while it’s not something I expect to become a regular occurrence, it made sense this time around.
lines.zh: 虽然我不指望这会变成常态，但这一次它说得通。

lines.en: And I didn’t even have to carry any boxes.
lines.zh: 而且我连箱子都不用搬。

$ otohadorm1 = True
{i}Otoha’s affection has increased to [otoha_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Otoha 的好感度提升到了 [otoha_love]!{/i}
